newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas little changed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas little changed in thin trade.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures got off to a slow start on Monday morning, with only two deals of 25 lots each done by 1200 GMT.
October traded once at 10.75 pence a therm, unchanged from the settlement level on Friday, while August 1998 traded at 10.20 pence, a fall of just 0.01 penny from Friday evening.

Although trade was quiet, a spokeswoman for the exchange said the IPE was encouraged by the level of trade in August. She added that trades are regularly getting done during the two-hour period when the market had closed for lunch until the contract's hours changed on August 8.
Front month September was bid at 8.91 pence and offered at 9.00 pence by 1200 GMT, with the new balance of the month contract bid at 8.92 pence but not offered.
